verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a SaaS financial-planning platform, but the evidence shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer could receive. The closest items are 'Proactive alerts & triggers', Ari messaging users when something moves, and a Slack app. These are chat or user notifications and adjacent features, not webhooks. The MCP server is pull-based client access, and no OpenAPI spec was found.
